#1. Import Files
##1.1 Data Files
```{r}
common_targets <- read.csv("figure_data/commonTargets.csv")
ppPSIM <- read.csv("../data/ppPSIMv3_RP.csv")
# Gene sets for GSEA
GO_file <- 'figure_data/goSLIMmod.gmt'
myGO = fgsea::gmtPathways(GO_file)
```

```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(msigdbr)
library(fgsea)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(cluster)
library(ggdendro)

# Assuming your dataframe 'common_targets' and the 'GO_file' variable are already loaded

# 1. Adjust predicted_change values based on 'category'
common_targets_adjusted <- common_targets %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(grep("_predicted_change$", names(.), value = TRUE)),
                ~ ifelse(grepl("Knockout", category), -., .)))

# 2. Prepare gene lists for GSEA from each '_predicted_change' column
predicted_change_cols <- grep("_predicted_change$", names(common_targets_adjusted), value = TRUE)
gene_lists <- list()

for (col in predicted_change_cols) {
  gene_lists[[col]] <- common_targets_adjusted %>%
    select(GQ_names, !!sym(col)) %>%
    na.omit() %>%
    distinct(GQ_names, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    arrange(desc(!!sym(col))) %>%
    pull(!!sym(col), name = GQ_names)
}

# 3. Load Gene Ontology (GO) terms from the .gmt file
GO_gmt <- gmtPathways(GO_file)

# 4. Run GSEA for each gene list
gsea_results_list <- list()
for (name in names(gene_lists)) {
  gsea_results <- fgsea(pathways = GO_gmt,
                        stats = gene_lists[[name]],
                        minSize = 3, # Adjust as needed
                        maxSize = 500, # Adjust as needed
                        nperm = 10000) # Consider increasing for publication quality
  if (!is.null(gsea_results) && nrow(gsea_results) > 0) {
    gsea_results$protein <- gsub("_predicted_change$", "", name)
    gsea_results_list[[name]] <- gsea_results
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("No significant GSEA results for %s\n", name))
  }
}

# Combine GSEA results into a single dataframe
if (length(gsea_results_list) > 0) {
  all_gsea_results <- bind_rows(gsea_results_list) 
} else {
  stop("No significant GSEA results found for any protein.")
}

# 5. Hierarchical clustering of GSEA pathways based on NES
if (nrow(all_gsea_results) > 0) {
  nes_matrix <- all_gsea_results %>%
    select(pathway, protein, NES) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = protein, values_from = NES, values_fill = 0) %>%
    column_to_rownames("pathway")

  if (nrow(nes_matrix) > 1) {
    d <- dist(nes_matrix)
    hc <- hclust(d, method = "ward.D2")
    pathway_order <- rownames(nes_matrix)[hc$order]
  } else {
    pathway_order <- rownames(nes_matrix)
    cat("Only one pathway found, skipping hierarchical clustering.\n")
  }
} else {
  stop("No significant pathways to perform hierarchical clustering.")
}

# 6. Create the dotplot
if (nrow(all_gsea_results) > 0) {
  dotplot <- ggplot(all_gsea_results,
                    aes(x = pathway,
                        y = protein,
                        size = size,
                        color = NES)) +
    geom_point() +
    scale_color_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", name = "NES") +
    #scale_size(name = "-log10(p-value)") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
          axis.title.x = element_blank(),
          axis.title.y = element_blank()) +
    scale_x_discrete(limits = pathway_order) # Apply hierarchical clustering order
} else {
  dotplot <- ggplot() +
    geom_text(aes(x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "No significant GSEA results to plot."),
              hjust = 0.5, vjust = 0.5) +
    theme_void()
}

# Print the dotplot
print(dotplot)
```
